notes: New Songs tab: paste any six-line ASCII guitar tab or import a MIDI file - parsed entirely on your device - and practice it with the app's engine: play through with your guitar tone, loop any bar range to drill a section, slow it down with the shared tempo and steps-per-beat, tap any note in the tab to jump there, and one tap applies the song's detected key to the whole app so the fretboard, piano and chords light up in it. Save songs to a local library.
